source: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 2.3.13 (reduction of live loads)

sources.influenceMin: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 2.3.13: members with KLL AT of 37.16 m² or more may be reduced (ASCE 7-05 Sec 4.8.1, SI)
sources.minOneFloor: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 2.3.13: at least 0.5 L0 for members supporting one floor, 0.4 L0 for two or more
sources.heavyLive: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 2.3.13: live loads over 4.79 kN/m² not reduced, except by 20 % on members supporting two or more floors
sources.notReduced: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 2.3.13: assembly uses not reduced
sources.twoFloorsOnly: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 2.3.13: passenger car garages (and heavy storage, over 4.79 kN/m²) only by 20 % on members supporting two or more floors
sources.kll: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 2.3.13, live load element factor KLL (ASCE 7-05 Table 4-2)
